lanTransfer.title: LAN transfer
lanTransfer.intro: Send audio, plugin files or plugin URLs from a phone or computer on the same local network. Reception stays open only while this page is in the foreground and closes after 15 minutes. Share the QR code and invitation only with trusted devices.
lanTransfer.noAddress: No local IPv4 address is available. Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
lanTransfer.invitation: Scan and connect in your browser, or open the address above and enter this one-time invitation:
lanTransfer.paired: Paired and ready to receive. Restart reception to pair another device.
lanTransfer.budget: Session budget used: {size} / 512 MiB. Audio limit: 256 MiB per file; plugin limit: 1 MiB.
lanTransfer.closeFailed: Unable to finish closing the receiver
lanTransfer.failed: Operation failed. Restart reception and try again.
lanTransfer.audio_imported: Audio imported into the TV library.
lanTransfer.plugin_installed: Plugin installed. Configure it on the TV.
lanTransfer.cancelled: Reception closed. Check the actual result on the TV.
lanTransfer.pairing_expired_or_invalid: Invitation invalid or already used. Restart reception on the TV.
lanTransfer.unauthorized: Connection invalid. Restart reception on the TV.
lanTransfer.insufficient_space: Not enough storage on the TV.
lanTransfer.audio_import_failed: Audio validation or saving failed. Check the TV result.
lanTransfer.plugin_install_failed: Plugin validation, download or saving failed. Check the TV result.
lanTransfer.source_changed: Plugin state on the TV changed. Send again.
lanTransfer.invalid_plugin_url: Enter an HTTP/HTTPS URL without a username, password or fragment.
lanTransfer.invalid_text: Plugin content must be UTF-8 text.
lanTransfer.capacity_exceeded: File size or session budget exceeded. Check the file and restart reception.
lanTransfer.upload_incomplete: Transfer interrupted or incomplete. Check the TV result.
lanTransfer.lan_address_changed: Network address changed. Refresh addresses and retry.
lanTransfer.lan_bind_failed: Cannot receive on this address. Refresh addresses and retry.
lanTransfer.busy: Receiver is still working. Try again shortly.
lanTransfer.webIntro: Keep the transfer page open on the TV. Leaving it or moving to the background closes reception. This connection uses unencrypted HTTP. Use a trusted network and do not send credentials or private files.
lanTransfer.codeLabel: One-time invitation shown on the TV
lanTransfer.pairHint: An invitation pairs one browser. After refreshing or changing browsers, restart reception on the TV.
lanTransfer.sendHint: Only send plugins you trust. Enter plugin configuration and passwords on the TV. One file is processed at a time, with up to 32 requests and a 512 MiB session budget (failed admitted uploads consume budget; URL installs reserve 1 MiB). Reception closes after 15 minutes.
lanTransfer.resultHint: A disconnect or browser error does not mean saving was undone. Check the TV result before retrying to avoid duplicate installation or import.
lanTransfer.enterCode: Enter the complete invitation shown on the TV.
lanTransfer.connected: Connected. Check the connection status on the TV before sending files.
lanTransfer.badFile: Select a file or URL within the size limit.
lanTransfer.sending: Sending and waiting for TV validation and saving. Keep this page open…
lanTransfer.disconnected: Connection interrupted. Check the TV result; saving may already have finished.

visuals.title: Player visuals
visuals.intro: Uses the desktop background, lyric and spectrum preferences. Performance mode adjusts local rendering without overwriting the selected effects.
visuals.loadFailed: Unable to load visual settings. Try again.
visuals.saveFailed: Saving failed or settings changed. Reload before trying again.
visuals.autoHint: Automatic mode reduces effects on low-memory or 32-bit Android devices. After TV player warm-up, effects are also reduced when at least 20 of 60 frames take over 32 ms to build or rasterize. This is not a GPU benchmark.
visuals.reducedHint: Reduced effects are active: a small static cover, with background/lyric blur, follow animation and spectrum disabled. Your effect selections are preserved.
visuals.fullHint: Rendering the selected effects. System reduced-motion preferences still disable animations.
visuals.slowHint: Slow TV frames were detected in this app session. Select Full effects to override, or restart the app to evaluate again.
